title: Scary Teacher 3D
description: Scary Teacher 3D is a popular stealth-horror game where players sneak into a scary teacher's house to teach her a lesson. Available on Steam with millions of installs across platforms.

title: Coin Sort
description: Coin Sort is a satisfying sorting puzzle game where players organize coins into the correct slots. Simple mechanics with addictive gameplay loop.

title: Traffic Jam Fever
description: Traffic Jam Fever is an addictive traffic management game where players must navigate vehicles through congested intersections. Features progressively challenging levels.

title: Police Quest
description: Police Quest is an action-packed game where players take on the role of a police officer, chasing criminals and maintaining order across thrilling missions.

title: Monster Truck Evolution
description: Monster Truck Evolution is a merge-and-evolve game featuring monster trucks. Combine trucks to unlock bigger and more powerful vehicles in this casual idle game.

title: Game Base - Unity Framework
description: Reusable project framework built on a ScriptableObject-driven data architecture with custom Unity Editor windows for level design and content authoring, cutting new project setup time by around 30%. Includes an in-game store and skin inventory system.

title: Mesh Fusion Tool
description: Unity Editor extension that merges multiple meshes into a single mesh and generates a material atlas, significantly reducing draw calls and improving GPU performance on mobile.
